description: Current delivery state of a fax: awaiting_payment, paid, submitted, sending, retry_wait, delivered, or failed. state is the UI-facing value (sending, retry_wait, delivered, or failed). Failed faxes include a reason you can act on. payment_status says where the money is: card payments are held (authorized) and captured only on delivery; a failed fax releases the hold (released). Automatic retries: attempt, max_attempts, next_attempt_at (null when none).
